places.name: 金龍ラーメン 道頓堀店 (Kinryu Ramen Dotonbori)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles in a pork-bone broth with a secret tare.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork-bone and chicken-feet broth, chashu.
places.hours_raw: Open 24 hours, every day (Tabelog; may change). Number tag: collect your bowl when called.
places.neighborhood: Dotonbori 1-chōme, under the giant dragon on the canal side — 5 min from Namba Stn exit 14
places.cuisine: 24-hour Minami ramen under the giant dragon · pork-bone and chicken-feet tonkotsu · ramen or chashu ramen only (ramen ¥900) · free kimchi, garlic and garlic chives · tatami seating
places.notes: [Ramen · the 24-hour bowl under Dotonbori's giant dragon] Minami's famous all-night ramen stand, known for the huge dragon sculpture over the shop. There are only two choices, ramen (¥900 in October 2026, after a ¥200 rise) or chashu ramen, in a tonkotsu the listing describes as rich, made from pork bones and chicken feet with a secret tare. Most 2026 diners found it surprisingly light, with medium-thin, slightly curly noodles. The fun is the free kimchi, garlic and garlic chives to load in. Take a number and carry your bowl from the counter to tatami or counter seats. Queues are mostly overseas visitors late at night but move fast. Opinions vary: a nostalgic finish to a night out for many, lukewarm and thin for one critic.

chef_bio.background: Multi-shop Minami brand (a reviewer notes the main shop is being rebuilt).
chef_bio.specialty: Tonkotsu ramen with free kimchi and garlic chives.

anecdotes.text: "The broth is pork bone-based but quite light. The noodles are thin, and the added garlic chives and kimchi gave it a nice spicy kick." — October 2026, ramen ¥900 after a night out.
"I remember it being JPY 600 back in my twenties, but now it's JPY 900." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 金龍ラーメン 道頓堀店、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-7-26、なんば駅14番出口徒歩5分、24時間営業、予約不可、カウンター・座敷、子ども可。店の紹介: 巨大な龍のオブジェで知られるミナミの24時間営業の名物店、豚骨と鶏ガラ(もみじ)を煮込んだ濃厚豚骨に秘伝のタレ、自家製のストレート麺、キムチ・にんにく・ニラ入れ放題。2026年の口コミ: インバウンド客が多い、中細のやや縮れ麺、醤油ベースの豚骨で塩気は控えめ・ぬるかったとの声、メニューはラーメンとチャーシューメンのみ、あっさりした豚骨、無料のキムチとニラが辛い、胡椒が合う、ラーメン900円(200円値上げ、20代の頃は600円)、本店は工事中、鶏と豚のブレンドで切れのある味、ラー油の香り、番号札で呼ばれて自分で運ぶ、回転が早い。

noodles.notes: House-made noodles (listing); diners describe them as medium-thin with a slight curl and lower water content (2026).

ramen.signature_bowl: ラーメン (ramen) — ¥900 in October 2026; チャーシューメン also offered.
ramen.chashu: Two kinds, sliced and cubed, on the sweet side (one 2026 review).
ramen.pantheon: Dotonbori after midnight: a light pork-bone bowl under the giant dragon, made your own with free kimchi, garlic and garlic chives, carried to the tatami on a number tag.

richness: "The broth is pork bone-based but quite light"; another: "surprisingly light" (https://tabelog.com/en/osaka/A2701/A270202/27001495/dtlrvwlst/B536645572/); the listing itself calls it rich.
oiliness: "Surprisingly light even after finishing my meal"; "lacks richness, it has a sharp finish" (https://tabelog.com/en/osaka/A2701/A270202/27001495/dtlrvwlst/B536670125/).
clarity: "The broth was a light tonkotsu" — a pork-bone broth; no source says it is clear.
tare_strength: "The seasoning is also sharp"; another found it "on the milder side in terms of saltiness" (https://tabelog.com/en/osaka/A2701/A270202/27001495/dtlrvwlst/B409489189/).
noodle_firmness: "Medium-thin with a slight curl, cooked just right… a lower water content"; the listing calls them firm.
aroma_punch: "The smell of tonkotsu broth was strong"; free kimchi and garlic chives add spice (https://tabelog.com/en/osaka/A2701/A270202/27001495/dtlrvwlst/B536384620/).

cultural_comfort.note: Number tag; carry your own bowl.

places.name: どうとんぼり神座 道頓堀店 (Dotonbori Kamukura)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles; the broth recipe is secret, and sides include kara-age and gyoza.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork slices and soft-boiled egg on the ramen; the secret broth is not described.
places.hours_raw: Daily 10:00–08:00 next morning (Tabelog). Order on the table tablet.
places.neighborhood: Dotonbori 1-chōme (1-7-25), next to Kinryū Ramen — 5 min from Namba Stn
places.cuisine: Dotonbori-born light ramen chain · secret broth with crunchy napa cabbage and fine-sliced pork · "delicious ramen" ¥850 · small chashu and soft-egg ramen ¥1,270 · seasonal hot-and-sour noodles · open 22 h
places.notes: [Ramen · Kamukura's light cabbage ramen on its home street] The Dotonbori shop of Kamukura, now a nationwide chain that long-time fans still call a local treasure, with 71 seats and open from 10:00 to 08:00 the next morning. The signature "delicious ramen" (¥850 in October 2026) is a light, gently sweet, secret-recipe broth heaped with crunchy napa cabbage and thin-sliced pork. The most popular version adds small chashu and a soft-boiled egg (¥1,270); there's kara-age (¥430), gyoza and seasonal bowls such as a hot-and-sour soup with Zhenjiang vinegar and cilantro. Order on the table tablet. It's easy to eat and veg-heavy, though one diner found it too salty, and the noodles are soft, almost udon-like.

chef_bio.origin: Dotonbori 1-chōme; a 2026 reviewer calls this the main branch

anecdotes.text: "Every time I visit, I ponder the mystery of the secret broth while enjoying the crisp napa cabbage and finely sliced pork that are its signature features." — September 2026, a fan since student days 35 years ago.

"I ordered the Most Popular Small Chashu and Soft-Boiled Egg Ramen (JPY 1270) along with Kara-age (JPY 430) using the tablet at my table." — September 2026, a first visit to what the reviewer calls the main branch.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: どうとんぼり神座 道頓堀店、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-7-25、なんば駅徒歩5分、71席、毎日10:00〜翌8:00、予約不可、公式サイト kamukura.co.jp。2026年の口コミ: 独特のあっさりスープに白菜、セットは大盛りで満腹、塩気が強すぎたとの声、本店と呼んで訪問、小チャーシュー煮玉子ラーメン1,270円と唐揚げ430円をタブレットで、旨みと甘みのスープとシャキシャキの白菜、観光客で賑わう、店舗により副菜が違う、隣の金龍の行列の横で空いていた、おいしいラーメン850円とハイボール430円、全国チェーン、35年前の学生時代から、秘伝のスープ・白菜・薄切り豚肉、大阪では女性客が多い、うどんのような麺、季節の酸辣湯麺(鎮江香酢・パクチー・蒸し鶏)と餃子。

noodles.notes: Soft noodles "with a texture similar to udon" (October 2026); another diner found them "nothing special".

places.name: 金久右衛門 道頓堀店 (Kinkuemon Dotonbori)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles in soy-sauce (shoyu) broths.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken stock with seafood, chashu.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Thu 11:00–08:00 next morning; Fri, Sat, Sun and holiday eves open 24 hours; closes early if sold out; open year-round (Tabelog). Ticket machine outside.
places.neighborhood: Dotonbori 1-chōme (1-4-17), a little off the main strip next to Kinryū — 5 min from Namba Stn
places.cuisine: Osaka Black shoyu ramen · jet-black soy broth with chicken stock and seafood umami · King Shoyu and clear Kinjou Shoyu · thin or thick noodles · extra noodles · ¥1,000–1,200 · open through the night
places.notes: [Ramen · Osaka Black, the jet-black shoyu, through the night] Since 2011 the Dotonbori branch of Kinkuemon, a shop famous for sharp shoyu ramen, set just off the main strip by the Kinryū queue. It has 41 seats over two floors and is open through the night (24 hours Friday to Sunday). The signature Osaka Black is a glossy jet-black soy broth with chicken stock and a seafood edge, buttery chicken-fat aroma and a faintly bitter soy finish. Choose thin noodles (most recommend them) or thick, topped with chashu, menma, green onion and a soft egg; extra noodles are extra. Also on the menu: Red Shoyu, King Shoyu, and Osaka Kinjou Shoyu, a clear chicken-and-light-soy broth that one 34-visit regular likes at 8 am. Buy a ticket at the machine outside; garlic on request. ¥1,000–1,200 a bowl; a few found it pricey for tourists or the service curt.

anecdotes.text: "The aroma of the rich black soy sauce combined with seafood in the jet-black broth was absolutely delightful! The straight, chewy thin noodles soaked up the black soy sauce soup." — October 2026, Osaka Black ¥1,200 at 5 am.
"The clear broth, made with chicken stock and light soy sauce, is perfect for a refreshing morning ramen." — September 2026, 34th visit, Kinjō Shoyu.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 金久右衛門 道頓堀店、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-4-17、41席(1階カウンター23、地下カウンター6・テーブル12)、月〜木11:00〜翌8:00、金土日祝前日24時間営業、売り切れ次第終了、年中無休、2011年12月29日開店、公式サイト king-emon-dotonbori.com。2026年の口コミ(英語版): 34回目の朝ラーメンで「Osaka Kinjou Shoyu」(鶏ガラと薄口醤油の澄んだスープ、細麺、にんにく、ねぎ、メンマ、半熟の味玉)、「Osaka Black」の大盛りと豚丼は2,000円超で観光客向けに高いとの声、店前の券売機、「Osaka Black」味玉なし1,000円、艶のある黒、ほろ苦い醤油と鶏油のバターのような香り、細麺がおすすめ、替え玉あり、基本1,200円、スタッフの対応がそっけないとの声、「Red Shoyu」、「King Shoyu」、豚骨の香りを感じたとの声、魚介の旨みのある「Osaka Black」、金龍の隣の行列のない店、朝5時に「Osaka Black」1,200円・細麺かため。

noodles.notes: Choice of thin (most recommended; straight and chewy) or thick noodles; firmness can be ordered (2026).

ramen.chashu: Chashu with menma, green onion and a seasoned soft egg.
ramen.pantheon: Minami's night-owl shoyu: a glossy jet-black soy broth with chicken stock and a seafood edge, buttery chicken fat, faintly bitter soy, and thin straight noodles that drink it all in.

richness: "Rich flavor with seafood umami… the broth has a delightful balance of soy sauce and seafood flavors, providing a refreshing taste."
oiliness: "The chicken fat has a rich buttery aroma."
clarity: "A nice glossy black appearance" — a dark shoyu chintan; the Kinjou Shoyu is "the clear broth" (https://tabelog.com/en/osaka/A2701/A270202/27062271/dtlrvwlst/B427234572/).
tare_strength: "The broth has a slightly bitter soy sauce flavor"; "a refreshing depth of soy sauce flavor and a hint of saltiness that was quite addictive" (https://tabelog.com/en/osaka/A2701/A270202/27062271/dtlrvwlst/B536118649/).
noodle_firmness: "Thin noodles and a firm texture… The straight, chewy thin noodles."
aroma_punch: "The aroma of the rich black soy sauce combined with seafood in the jet-black broth was absolutely delightful!"

places.name: らぁ麺 はやし田 道頓堀店 (Ramen Hayashida Dotonbori)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: whole-wheat-flour noodles in shoyu, paitan and tsukemen bowls.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: duck and Daisen-chicken broth, chashu, egg.
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–23:00 (Tabelog; may change). Ticket machine at the entrance.
places.neighborhood: Dotonbori Kankō Bldg B1F, right under the Glico sign by Ebisubashi — 3 min from Namba Stn
places.cuisine: Tokyo Shinjuku shoyu ramen brand under the Glico sign · duck and Daisen-chicken clear shoyu (¥900; special ¥1,200) · chicken paitan · tsukemen · seasonal yuzu cold ramen · TKG and oyakodon sides
places.notes: [Ramen · Tokyo's Hayashida right under the Glico sign] The first Kansai branch, opened in 2022, of Ramen Hayashida, a Shinjuku shop famous for queues and run by INGS Co. It's a 16-seat counter one floor below the Glico running man, southwest of Ebisubashi. The signature is a clear shoyu broth of duck and Daisen-dori chicken (¥900; the special with a "Maximum Koitama" egg ¥1,200) on firm, thin whole-wheat noodles, with pork-shoulder and chicken-breast chashu. There's also a creamy chicken paitan, a refined tsukemen (special ¥1,250), mazesoba with truffle-sauce egg, and summer yuzu cold ramen (¥950) with yuzu jelly. Add a TKG or oyakodon (¥350–400). Buy tickets at the entrance machine. Light and quick, with friendly staff: a handy fast lunch when Minami's big names are queuing.

chef_bio.origin: Opened 11 February 2022 (Tabelog); first Kansai branch of the Shinjuku shop (2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Brand of INGS Co., Ltd. (Shinjuku); franchise (July 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: "'ralamen hayashida' is a brand of INGS Co., Ltd., headquartered in Shinjuku, Tokyo, and this is their first franchise location in the Kansai region… right under the towering 20-meter 'Dotonbori Glico Sign'." — July 2026, shoyu ramen ¥900.

"Special Shoyu Ramen (JPY 1,200)… firm, thin noodles made with whole wheat flour, topped with a rich flavored egg made from the premium 'Maximum Koitama' brand, and tender chicken chashu." — October 2026.

places.name: ラー麺ずんどう屋 道頓堀店 (Ramen Zundoya Dotonbori)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles in a pork-bone soy broth; sides include gyoza and kara-age.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork-bone broth with back fat, pork-belly chashu.
places.hours_raw: Open 24 hours, every day (Tabelog; may change). Ticket machine in front; seating upstairs.
places.neighborhood: Sōemonchō 7-6, just east of Ebisubashi — 3 min from Namba Stn
places.cuisine: Himeji-born back-fat tonkotsu shoyu chain · motomi ramen ¥860, ajitama ¥980, all-toppings ¥1,360 · pick back-fat level (light to extra rich) and thin or curly noodles · table pickled ginger, garlic, takana · 24 h
places.notes: [Ramen · Himeji back-fat tonkotsu, round the clock] The Dotonbori branch, opened 31 October 2025, of Zundōya, a Himeji-founded chain with over a hundred shops (about 106 in Japan and 4 in Shanghai, per a December 2025 visitor). It sits just east of Ebisubashi and is open 24 hours. The broth is pork bone with a slightly creamy soy seasoning and as much back fat as you choose (light, regular, rich or extra rich). Noodles are house-made: ultra-thin straight (recommended) or curly. The motomi (original) ramen is ¥860, ajitama ¥980, and all-toppings up to ¥1,360; summer brought a cold ramen with grated daikon. Season at the table with pepper, pickled ginger, garlic, chili oil, sesame and takana. Buy a ticket outside (transit IC accepted) and head upstairs. A Kansai-friendly tonkotsu with a hint of sweetness.

anecdotes.text: "The broth is made from pork bone, featuring a slightly creamy soy sauce soup with added back fat… The noodles are house-made, straight, and thin, providing a pleasant texture with just the right amount of chewiness." — October 2025, opening day.
"The broth is rich and fatty, yet not overwhelming, packed with meaty flavors… The firm noodles pair perfectly with the large seaweed." — May 2026, late night.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ラー麺ずんどう屋 道頓堀店、大阪市中央区宗右衛門町7-6、なんば駅から277m、24時間営業、予約不可、2025年10月31日開店、公式サイト zundouya.com。口コミ(2025年10月〜2026年9月): 姫路に本店のチェーンの新店、元味らーめん860円(豚骨醤油に背脂)、極細ストレート麺2.00mm、豚バラのチャーシュー、ねぎ、海苔、メニュー(チャーシュー1,400円、味玉980円、ねぎ980円、HOT930円、全部のせ1,360円、野菜1,060円、バターコーンなど)、替え玉150円、背脂は4段階(あっさり・ふつう・こってり・こってり増し)、細麺か縮れ麺を選べる、卓上に胡椒・紅生姜・にんにく・ラー油・ごま・高菜、国内106店と上海4店、全部のせチャーシューと祭りセット(餃子と唐揚げ)、宗右衛門町、戎橋の東、関西向けの姫路豚骨でほんのり甘い、深夜にこってりでもくどくない、硬めの麺と大きな海苔、券売機で交通系ICで冷やしおろしらーめん960円、2階の店内。

noodles.notes: House-made ultra-thin straight noodles (2.00 mm), or curly noodles on request (2025–26).

ramen.signature_bowl: 元味らーめん (motomi ramen) — ¥860; 味玉らーめん ¥980 (October 2025).
ramen.chashu: Pork-belly chashu, thick and tender on the all-toppings bowl.
ramen.pantheon: Himeji's answer to Hakata on Dotonbori's east side: a pork-bone soy broth whose back fat you set yourself, ultra-thin house noodles, and a table of ginger, garlic and takana, all night.

richness: "A rich pork bone-based soy sauce broth with added back fat."
oiliness: "The broth is rich and fatty, yet not overwhelming"; back fat chosen from four levels (https://tabelog.com/en/osaka/A2701/A270202/27152648/dtlrvwlst/B516387909/).
clarity: "A slightly creamy soy sauce soup with added back fat" — an opaque pork-bone broth.
tare_strength: "The moderate soy sauce seasoning enhances the richness of the pork broth."

places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat-wrapper gyoza, fried rice and Chinese stir-fries in soy-based sauces.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork gyoza, beef and pork stir-fries, mapo tofu, kara-age.

places.cuisine: Osaka Ohsho chain’s Dotonbori main shop · juicy gyoza · gyoza sets with fried rice or kara-age · hoikoro, mapo tofu, green-pepper beef · lu-su fried rice · 189 seats, upstairs river views
places.notes: [Gyoza · Osaka Ohsho's main shop on Dotonbori] The Dotonbori main shop of the Osaka Ohsho gyoza chain: 189 seats over two floors, with back tables upstairs looking over the canal, and touch-panel ordering and payment. The gyoza are the reason to come: juicy enough that one fan skips the dipping sauce. Sets pair them with fried rice (generous chashu), kara-age or a hoikoro set meal (¥1,320 with gyoza). The menu also has mapo tofu, green-pepper beef, chilled Chinese noodles and the punchy lu-su fried rice (¥1,200 as a gyoza set). Plain gyoza are ¥700 here, which one visitor found steep, and the service at the flagship disappointed another. Fast and easy, with a take-out counter.

"The gyoza here is flavorful on its own, so you don’t need any dipping sauce… The gyoza is juicy, with the meat juices bursting out like in xiaolongbao." — June 2026.

places.name: 一蘭 なんば御堂筋店 (Ichiran Namba Midosuji)
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the broth is built from beef bones and chicken; beef replaces pork chashu.
places.hours_raw: Daily 9:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:45); open year-round (Tabelog; check the official site for changes). Waits of 30–80 minutes are common; take a QR number.
places.neighborhood: Shinsaibashisuji 2-4-2, Gurukasu City Bldg 2F — 3 min from Namba Stn exit 14
places.cuisine: Ichiran’s "100% no tonkotsu" branch · creamy beef-bone and chicken broth with the red secret sauce · beef "gyūyarō" instead of pork chashu · order sheet for firmness and richness · booth counters · ¥1,280
places.notes: [Ramen · Ichiran's pork-free "no tonkotsu" shop] The one Ichiran operating under its "100% no tonkotsu used" concept: the familiar experience (booth counters with partitions, an order sheet, Arita-ware bowls) but a broth developed from beef bones and chicken, so people who can't eat pork can have Ichiran. Diners call it surprisingly rich and creamy, very like tonkotsu, with the signature red secret sauce. One found it lacked real tonkotsu's punch. Instead of pork chashu there's sweet-spicy seasoned beef (gyūyarō), plus soft salted egg, extra garlic and a matcha pudding. The 100% pork-free ramen was ¥1,280 in July 2026. Expect 30–80-minute waits (scan a QR code and return); a 9 am weekday arrival walked straight in. 25 seats, many overseas visitors.

chef_bio.background: Ichiran chain (ichiran.com); this branch uses a pork-free broth (2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: "This location is quite unique among Ichiran branches, as it operates under the special concept of '100% no tonkotsu used.' They provide a special broth developed using beef bones and other ingredients, ensuring that those who cannot eat pork or pork bones can still enjoy the deliciousness of Ichiran." — June 2026.
"100% Pork Bone-Free Ramen + Soft-Boiled Salted Egg + Extra Gyuu Yaro for JPY 1820. The '100% Pork Bone-Free Ramen' itself costs JPY 1280." — July 2026, right after 9 am opening.

places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles in a pork-bone broth.
places.hours_raw: Open 24 hours, every day (Tabelog; may change). Ticket machine; mostly standing. Smoking allowed (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Namba 1-7-12, on Midōsuji under the big dragon sign — 3 min from Namba Stn
places.cuisine: Kinryū’s yatai-style standing branch on Midōsuji · light tonkotsu ramen ¥900 · free kimchi, garlic and garlic chives · open kitchen, pavement-side tables · 24 h · smoking allowed
places.notes: [Ramen · Kinryū's standing yatai on Midōsuji] One of Kinryū's several Namba shops, under a big dragon sign on Midōsuji. It's done in a food-stall style: buy a ticket, then mostly stand at the counter or use the tables by the pavement, with the kitchen in full view. Like the Dotonbori shop, it serves a simple tonkotsu ramen (¥900) that most find lighter than its strong pork aroma suggests, plus free kimchi, garlic and garlic chives to pile on. A seven-time visitor praises the old-school simplicity of a shop that has served for over 35 years; a first-timer was underwhelmed. Turnover is quick and it's open 24 hours, handy at 2 am. Smoking is allowed (Tabelog).
